Our Story

Founded by Gary & Willie in 2021

Corrimac Waste Solutions was established in 2021 by Gary and Willie, and has provided waste uplift and disposal services ever since — built on turning up when we say we will, treating people and properties with respect, and disposing of waste the right way.

Corrimac is a SEPA-registered company providing residential and commercial waste uplift and disposal — from single-item collections and household waste removal to complete house and property clearances for homeowners, landlords, letting agents and businesses.

Reliable. Professional. Responsible.

Why Choose Us

Why customers choose Corrimac

Anyone can hire a van. Corrimac gives you a registered, reliable team that does the job properly — and leaves the place tidy.

SEPA Registered Carrier

Your waste is carried legally by a SEPA-registered carrier — never fly-tipped, and never dumped where it should not be.

Responsible Disposal

Everything we uplift goes to proper, licensed disposal and recycling routes — sorted and handled the way it should be.

We Do All the Lifting

Stairs, tight hallways, heavy furniture — our team handles the lifting, loading and sweeping up. You just point at what goes.

Straightforward Quotes

Tell us what needs cleared and where, and we will give you a clear, honest quote before any work starts. No pressure, no obligation.

Reliable & On Time

We arrange a collection time and stick to it. If anything changes, you will hear it from us first — simple, professional communication.

A Local Team You Can Trust

When you contact Corrimac, you deal with the business Gary and Willie built — people who answer to their customers, not a national call centre.

Commercial Partnerships

A clearance partner your clients can rely on

Property professionals trust Corrimac for dependable, discreet clearances — one point of contact, a registered carrier, and properties left ready for what is next.

Letting Agents

End-of-tenancy and void-property clearances arranged quickly, so homes go back on the market without delay.

Landlords

Left-behind furniture and belongings removed between lets — single properties or whole portfolios.

Solicitors

Sensitive estate and probate clearances handled carefully and respectfully, with clear communication throughout.

Property Managers

A dependable uplift service for managed blocks, units and estates — one call covers clearances big and small.

How It Works

Cleared in four simple steps

No skips to fill, no trips to the tip, no heavy lifting. Here is how a Corrimac clearance works from start to finish.

01

02
